title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Geospatial Analytics Platform
description: We need an end-to-end geospatial analytics dashboard that ingests municipal parcel and zoning datasets, runs spatial joins and proximity analysis on a PostGIS backend, and renders interactive choropleth maps for urban planners. The existing system is a Django monolith with slow ad-hoc SQL, no caching, and 8+ second query times on large parcels. We want a migration to Next.js App Router with React Server Components, a typed Node.js service layer, and a PostGIS schema with GiST indexes, ST_Intersects and ST_DWithin pipelines, plus vector tile caching.

title: Backend Engineer - Serverless Observability Pipeline
description: We are building a real-time observability platform that ingests millions of events per day from customer SDKs, normalizes them, and triggers alerting and anomaly detection rules. The current pipeline is a brittle batch ETL job that drops events under load. We need a serverless event-driven architecture on AWS: API Gateway or Kinesis ingestion, Lambda processors, Step Functions orchestration, DynamoDB for hot storage, and S3 for cold storage with Athena analytics.
success_criteria: Zero event loss at 3x peak load

title: ML Engineer - LLM Agent Automation Pipeline
description: We need an LLM agent pipeline that automates customer support triage, ticket summarization, and knowledge-base drafting. The agent must use retrieval-augmented generation over internal docs, function calling into our CRM and ticketing APIs, and guardrails to prevent hallucinated actions. We run open-weight models and need a fine-tuning loop so the agent adopts our brand voice. You will design the orchestration layer, the RAG retrieval stack, and the evaluation harness.

title: Geospatial Backend Engineer - Municipal Spatial Data
description: We provide municipalities with a spatial data API for zoning, flood-risk, and transport planning. We need a high-performance PostGIS backend that exposes GeoJSON APIs, supports dynamic tiling, and handles concurrent spatial queries over tens of millions of geometries. The role covers schema design, spatial indexing strategy, query optimization, and containerized deployment.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - AI-Powered Logistics Dashboard
description: We need a logistics operations dashboard that tracks shipments in real time, predicts delivery delays with an LLM-assisted forecasting module, and lets dispatchers re-route trucks with one click. The front end is Next.js, the back end is Node.js with a PostgreSQL database, and an AI module summarizes exception events and drafts customer notifications. You will build the full stack and integrate the LLM module with human-in-the-loop approvals.
success_criteria: Human approval gate for AI messages
